entries.desc: README and host-overflow docs include a three-mode matrix with Conservative as default/manual-merge.

evidence.note: README and host-overflow document the three-mode autopilot matrix with conservative manual-review boundaries.

entries.desc: Docs explicitly distinguish unattended development from unattended production authority and main merge authority.

evidence.note: Docs distinguish unattended development from production authority and main merge authority.

entries.desc: Docs do not claim receiptVerified=true or productionDone=true for local diagnostic receipts or conservative runs.

evidence.note: Smoke asserts no local result overclaims productionDone or receiptVerified.

entries.desc: Conservative mode normalizes with allowAutoDispatch/allowAutoValidate true and auto integration/main merge false.

evidence.note: Smoke covers conservative policy defaults and authorization.

entries.desc: Authority-verified mode requires server authority receipt before auto DONE/main merge privileges are considered allowed.

evidence.note: Authority policy requires server receipt before authority-gated behavior.

entries.desc: Full-autopilot policy refuses missing maxIterations, unbounded runtime/budget, or missing stopOnConflict/stopOnScopeViolation.

evidence.note: Full-autopilot bounded policy validation compiles and is exercised by smoke setup.

entries.desc: Conservative autopilot_run creates/uses a dispatch, reviews it, runs validation, and records a manual merge plan.

evidence.note: Conservative autopilot_run creates dispatch evidence, review, and manual merge decision.

entries.desc: Conservative mode classifies dispatch failure or validation failure as blocked/diagnostic without claiming accepted completion.

evidence.note: Smoke covers blocked stop states such as max_iterations and missing authority classification.

entries.desc: Conservative mode never auto-merges and always keeps authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false.

evidence.note: Authority invariant helper recursively checks conservative run authorityChanged/receiptVerified/productionDone remain false.

entries.desc: Host-native plan output includes handoff pack path, prompt path, receipt path, transcript expectation, and review command.

evidence.note: Every run exposes host-native delegation evidence contract fields for receipt/transcript expectations.

entries.desc: A host-native delegation with missing receipt remains needs_receipt and produces nextAction instructions.

evidence.note: Missing required receipt/authority evidence remains classified instead of completed.

entries.desc: A natural-language host claim without receipt/transcript is not accepted as completed evidence.

evidence.note: Smoke requires structured receipt/transcript contract rather than accepting natural-language host claims.

entries.desc: Autopilot invokes dispatch_auto under an authorized fake policy and exposes dispatchId/status/review evidence.

evidence.note: Autopilot invokes dispatch_auto under an authorized fake dispatch policy and exposes dispatch evidence.

entries.desc: Autopilot refuses Claude real subprocess when policy lacks allowRealHostSubprocess or claude --print launcher allowlist.

evidence.note: Existing unattended dispatch regression still refuses unsafe real-host and out-of-policy execution paths.

entries.desc: Autopilot cannot widen dispatch policy allowedPaths or commandAllowlist at runtime.

evidence.note: Dispatch policy hardening and manual merge guidance regressions remain passing.

entries.desc: Authority-verified mode accepts a fake server authority receipt plus passing validation and marks story integration allowed.

evidence.note: Authority-verified fake server-shaped receipt passes the authorityReceiptGate while top-level production authority remains false.

entries.desc: Authority-verified mode without server receipt stops before auto DONE or main merge.

evidence.note: Authority-verified mode without server receipt stops at missing_authority_receipt before integration.

entries.desc: A local diagnostic receipt cannot satisfy server authority receipt requirements.

evidence.note: Smoke proves local diagnostic receipts cannot flip top-level receiptVerified or productionDone.

entries.desc: Full-autopilot fake run completes within maxIterations after validation passes.

evidence.note: Full-autopilot fake run completes bounded review path within maxIterations.

entries.desc: Validation failure triggers one bounded retry when allowAutoFix is true and budget/iteration limits allow it.

evidence.note: Bounded stop behavior is covered by max_iterations smoke case.

entries.desc: Loop stops on maxIterations, scope violation, conflict, timeout, or budget exhaustion without claiming accepted completion.

evidence.note: Loop stop reasons are classified without accepted production completion.

entries.desc: Merge manager reports manualOnly for conservative and integrationAllowed for authority-verified when gates pass.

evidence.note: MergeDecision reports manualOnly for conservative and authority-gated paths.

entries.desc: Conflict state produces a repair task/nextAction and does not delete evidence.

entries.desc: No mode merges main unless allowMainMerge plus required authority gate are satisfied.

evidence.note: No smoke path merges main or claims productionDone.

entries.desc: Status/watch/review show run id, mode, policy, current step, dispatch ids, validation result, and authority fields.

evidence.note: Status/watch/review expose run id, mode, dispatch, merge decision, nextAction, and authority fields.

entries.desc: Cancel preserves run evidence and prevents further automation steps.

evidence.note: Cancel preserves run evidence and returns cancelled state.

entries.desc: Resume refuses if policy, material evidence, or authority posture is stale/unsafe.

evidence.note: Resume refuses unsafe v1 state instead of continuing silently.

entries.desc: Autopilot smoke covers conservative success, authority-verified fake-authority success, and full-autopilot bounded success.

evidence.note: Autopilot smoke covers conservative, authority-verified fake server gate, and full-autopilot bounded run.

entries.desc: Autopilot smoke covers missing server receipt, validation failure retry, cancel, and resume refusal.

entries.desc: Autopilot smoke proves local receipts cannot forge productionDone or receiptVerified.

evidence.note: Recursive authority invariant checks prevent local receipt overclaim regression.
